reasoning: The one-line `if (status === 404) { return new NotFound("missing"); }` becomes `if (404 === status) { ... }`. The test pins `expect(errorForOneLine(404)).toBeInstanceOf(NotFound)` and `expect(errorForOneLine(403)).toBeInstanceOf(Forbidden)`. The conditional, equality and block mutants of the line fail the test, but the string mutant `new NotFound("")` passes, because a class pin never reads the message. RIPR-SPEC-0249 example 7: a one-line `if (c) { return ...; }` is not credited. ripr reads both pins `relational_check` / weak and reports `weakly_exposed`, matching the spec and the partial truth.
